paragraphs.text: Auvernine is a Witherbloom student at Strixhaven on Arcavios .

Auvernine is practical and down-to-earth, often voicing a pragmatic view on conflicts. She prefers avoiding unnecessary confrontations and sees the senselessness in certain duels between the colleges. This level-headedness and her inclination towards reasoned action are evident in her interactions with her friends, Rowan Kenrith and Plink . Additionally, she cares about her friends' well-being, shown when she encourages Rowan to maintain a relationship with her brother, Will .

Auvernine was present during various key events on the Strixhaven campus. She was part of the conversation at the Bow's End Tavern where Rowan met with her after classes. During the attack on Witherbloom College, she fought alongside Rowan and Plink , using her magic to entangle enemies and protect her friends. Despite the chaos, she tried to suggest waiting for professors' help, showcasing her tendency to seek authority and structured assistance in dire situations. Eventually, she accompanied Rowan and Plink to reach the Biblioplex for safety and strategic advantage.
